posts.author: Arturo
posts.content_md:
Hello all,

While some interesting topic arises, I thought it would be a good idea to create a world-map with holographers, studios, companies, galleries, and suppliers. I started this at:

[http://maps.google.es/maps/ms?msid=2152 ... 1366797026](http://maps.google.es/maps/ms?msid=215231370508059121428.0004db17dcc1436805511&msa=0&ll=40.416633,-3.703766&spn=0.401493,0.617294&mid=1366797026)

I am not sure if you need a google account to modify/add data. In any case, if you want to be there (please), feel free to add yourself, or answer this thread, and I will do so for you. Please, make sure you state, before your name, a category, in the form of: [PRO] [AMATEUR] [COMPANY] [SUPPLIER] [GALLERY]

Thanks

I think Martina Mrongovius the head of the center of holographic arts was planning a holographer map aswell if I remember correctly.

I can tell you that I am doing holography and I am living in Berlin. I did have a lab until recently but not anymore.

I know of another holographer in Hamburg. Everythingn else holography related in Germany seems to be centered in cologne with the big holo lab at the KHM ( school of media arts cologne)

Martina works there when she's not traveling the world
